## Objective
- Build FIELD OPS, a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 3D FPS with multiple maps, random spawns, AI combat, and a real-player mode.

## Requirements
- Create the game without asking clarifying questions.
- Aim for a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare-like experience with “ultra graphics,” multiple maps, random spawning, AI and real-player modes, and phone/tablet support.

## Decisions
- Built FIELD OPS as an original browser FPS with a custom tactical visual style.
- “Online Operators” explains that no game server is available and opens a local practice lobby.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game shell, menu, HUD, pause/end screens, and touch controls in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Implemented six maps, AI bots, movement, shooting, reloading, damage/respawn, HUD/minimap, keyboard/mouse/touch controls, pause and end states in `game.js`.
- Reset ammo reserve to 180 and spawn the player at a random unblocked point on deployment.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser checks confirmed ammo starts at 30, reserve is 180, and mobile fire reduces ammo.
- Adjusted mobile HUD layout in `styles.css`: moved location label below the objective, repositioned the joystick to avoid bottom HUD overlap, and raised reload/toast messages.

### Active
- Validate mobile movement, look, fire, aim, reload, and jump, plus desktop movement and map cycling.
- Inspect the updated mobile layout and review gameplay balance; earlier idle testing showed bots can deal damage quickly at close range.

### Blocked
- Real multiplayer requires a game server; the online option currently opens a local practice lobby.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png` after recapturing it with the latest CSS changes.
2. Test mobile movement, look, fire, aim, reload, and jump; verify desktop movement and map cycling.
3. Recheck browser console/game states and run `node --check game.js` after any code changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, maps, bots, gameplay, HUD, and input.
- `index.html`: Game shell, menu, HUD, screens, and mobile control markup.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
- `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png`: Mobile viewport capture to refresh and inspect.
- `screenshots/gameplay.png`: Earlier in-game preview.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` previously showed new files `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css`.
- Browser is available at `http://localhost:3002`; earlier checks saw a `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL software-rendering performance warnings, with no gameplay JavaScript errors observed.
- Playwright’s regular click on `#fire-touch` timed out because the touch control intercepts pointer events; `playwright-cli run-code "async (page) => { await page.locator('#fire-touch').click({force:true}); }"` successfully fired and reduced ammo.

## Objective
- Build FIELD OPS, a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 3D FPS with multiple maps, random spawns, AI combat, and a real-player mode.

## Requirements
- Create the game without asking clarifying questions.
- Aim for a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare-like experience with “ultra graphics,” multiple maps, random spawning, AI and real-player modes, and phone/tablet support.

## Decisions
- Built FIELD OPS as an original browser FPS with a custom tactical visual style.
- “Online Operators” explains that no game server is available and opens a local practice lobby.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game shell, menu, HUD, pause/end screens, and touch controls in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Implemented six maps, AI bots, movement, shooting, reloading, damage/respawn, HUD/minimap, keyboard/mouse/touch controls, pause and end states in `game.js`.
- Reset ammo reserve to 180 and made deployment spawn at a random unblocked point.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser checks confirmed starting ammo and that mobile fire reduces ammo.
- Updated mobile layout in `styles.css` for the location label, joystick, reload indicator, and toast placement.

### Active
- Validate mobile movement, look, fire, aim, reload, and jump; verify desktop movement and map cycling.
- Inspect refreshed `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png` and review gameplay balance; earlier idle testing showed bots can deal damage quickly at close range.

### Blocked
- Real multiplayer requires a game server; the online option currently opens a local practice lobby.

1. Recapture and inspect `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png` after the latest CSS changes.
2. Test mobile controls and desktop movement/map cycling; check browser console and game states.
3. Run `node --check game.js` after any code changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, menu, HUD, screens, and mobile control markup.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, maps, bots, gameplay, HUD, and input.
- `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png`: Mobile viewport capture to refresh and inspect.
- `screenshots/gameplay.png`: Earlier in-game preview.

- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status --short` showed new files `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `styles.css`.
